department: Neuroscience Center Zurich (ZNZ, ETH and UZH)

deadline.value: The ZNZ programme is not recruiting through the LSZGS portal for now; contact ZNZ group leaders about openings at any time.
deadline.quote: Until further notice we do not recruit PhD students via the Life Science Zurich Graduate School online application portal (Track 1).

also.quote: Neuroscience (only for the deadlines of 1 November 2026 and 1 May 2027)

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

supervisor.value: Apply directly to a ZNZ group leader (Track II); registration starts once you and the supervisor agree on a project and a funded position.
supervisor.quote: You can contact ZNZ group leaders directly to enquire about PhD openings and apply to the group of your choice (Track II). | If the candidate and the future supervisor have both agreed on the PhD research project and a position is provided by the supervisor, the registration process can be started.

funding.value: The supervisor provides the position and the group handles the employment contract.
funding.quote: a position is provided by the supervisor

entry_route.value: A completed university Master's degree is required before you can register for the doctorate.
entry_route.quote: You must have a university Master's degree.

notes: Joint ETH/UZH programme; you matriculate at ETH if your supervisor is at ETH. Group leaders must hold a formal admission interview with another PI present.
name: ZNZ PhD Program in Neuroscience
